title: Upgrade Traffic Jam player vehicle visuals to a smaller race car with new texture

requirements.summary: Revise the 3D player car model to a clearly recognizable small race-car silhouette while keeping all gameplay behavior unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: In gameplay, the only vehicle (player car) has a clearly recognizable race-car style silhouette (e.g., low profile body, sportier proportions, racing details such as a simple spoiler/wing or aerodynamic shapes).
The player car is visually smaller than before (reduced overall scale) while remaining clearly visible on mobile.
Gameplay behavior is unchanged: steering, speed progression, scoring, and collision detection outcomes remain the same as before this change.
No additional vehicles are introduced; only the player car is present as a vehicle.

file_operations.description: Update the player car’s Three.js mesh composition to look like a small sport/race car (lower profile chassis, more aerodynamic front/rear shaping, and a simple spoiler/wing), and reduce the model’s visual scale (e.g., via the returned group scale) while keeping the same public API and without touching any control/speed/score/collision logic.

Confirm the scene continues to use the existing gameplay collision dimensions/constants and player positioning logic unchanged; if any visual scale adjustments require minor positioning tweaks for ground contact, keep them visual-only (do not alter scoring/speed/steering/collision outcomes).

requirements.summary: Replace the player car body texture with a new generated racing-style texture and ensure it maps cleanly on the car model.
acceptanceCriteria: The player car no longer uses /assets/generated/traffic-jam-player-car-texture.dim_1024x512.png as its primary body texture.
A new racing-style texture from frontend/public/assets/generated is used on the player car body material(s).
The new texture appears correctly oriented (not mirrored unintentionally) and looks sharp (no obvious stretching) on the car body.

file_operations.description: Add the new generated racing-style texture asset (bold stripes and a simple number panel) as a static frontend asset at this exact path/filename.

Switch the loaded texture from frontend/public/assets/generated/traffic-jam-player-car-texture.dim_1024x512.png to frontend/public/assets/generated/race-car-texture.dim_1024x512.png, and adjust material/texture settings (e.g., flipY/wrapping/anisotropy as appropriate) to prevent unintended mirroring and reduce visible stretching on the main body surfaces.
